title: Add DSC v3 profile resource to deploy key and shortcut remappings
author: Gijsreyn
summary: The live upstream head remains unchanged and the replacement fork review is rebased on current upstream main with an exact 26-file scope match. Debug x64 essentials, PowerToys.DSC, and PowerToys.DSC.UnitTests builds passed, and the complete DSC test assembly passed 101/101 after safeguarding the user's settings and stopping the live PowerToys process that locked settings.json. The high-confidence test-isolation finding remains supported, but a freshly requested Copilot review of the rebased fork head had not submitted on the required single immediate check. The author also requested another authorized Azure Pipelines run upstream, which was not performed because upstream writes are prohibited.
